purpose: Determine whether the seven complete three-run persistent retrieval misses have answer-bearing gold documents present in the frozen local index before selecting another retrieval or corpus mechanism.
claim_boundary: This audit uses gold document IDs and answers from an outcome-selected development failure cluster. Passing means only that indexed answer-bearing documents exist for a majority of these cases, selecting retrieval rank/index representation as the next diagnostic layer. It is not a retrieval improvement, end-to-end accuracy result, official benchmark result, or model capability improvement.
